text.en:
<stasis/>Stasis Shards now grant <stasis/>Frost Armor upon pickup:
• Small Stasis Shards grant x1 <stasis/>Frost Armor, 10% Melee Ability Energy, and restore 10 HP.
• Large Stasis Shards grant x3 <stasis/>Frost Armor, 50% Melee Ability Energy, and restore 20 HP.

While <stasis/>Frost Armor is active: 
• <kinetic/>Kinetic and <stasis/>Stasis Weapon Kills have an escalating chance to trigger a <stasis/>Stasis Shatter based on the number of <stasis/>Frost Armor stacks.
• Taking damage grants ?% Melee Ability energy (once per second).

<bold Intrinsic to All Stasis Subclasses: />
Stasis Shards are generated by:
• Shattering a <stasis/>Frozen target or <stasis/>Stasis Crystal
• Defeating a <stasis/>Stasis-Debuffed (Slowed or Frozen) target

Minor combatants generate a small <stasis/>Stasis Crystal, while Elites, Minibosses, and Guardians generate a Large <stasis/>Stasis Crystal.

<bold/><pvp In PvP Only: /> 
Stasis Shards go on a 10 second cooldown upon creating 6 shards within ? seconds of the first.
